label: Bible Study
prompt: For then will I turn to the people a pure _____, that they may all call upon the name of the LORD, to serve him with one consent.
verse: For then will I turn to the people a pure language, that they may all call upon the name of the LORD, to serve him with one consent.
note: A promise to reverse Babel — one pure language, everyone calling on the LORD together.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: For every one that asketh receiveth; and he that seeketh findeth; and to him that knocketh it shall be _____.
verse: For every one that asketh receiveth; and he that seeketh findeth; and to him that knocketh it shall be opened.
note: Asketh, seeketh, knocketh — and no knock in this verse goes unanswered. Every one finds the door opened.

label: Sunday School
prompt: This our bread we took hot for our provision out of our houses on the day we came forth to go unto you; but now, behold, it is dry, and it is _____:
verse: This our bread we took hot for our provision out of our houses on the day we came forth to go unto you; but now, behold, it is dry, and it is mouldy:
note: The Gibeonites' trick: show off mouldy bread as 'proof' of a long journey — and Israel didn't ask God first.

label: Deep Water
prompt: And the seventh angel sounded; and there were great voices in heaven, saying, The kingdoms of this world are become the kingdoms of our Lord, and of his Christ; and he shall _____ for ever and ever.
verse: And the seventh angel sounded; and there were great voices in heaven, saying, The kingdoms of this world are become the kingdoms of our Lord, and of his Christ; and he shall reign for ever and ever.
note: The seventh trumpet's announcement — Handel set these very words in the 'Hallelujah' chorus of Messiah.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And have no fellowship with the _____ works of darkness, but rather reprove them.
verse: And have no fellowship with the unfruitful works of darkness, but rather reprove them.
note: Darkness produces nothing worth keeping: its works are 'unfruitful' — so don't join in; expose them.
